svg.title: Figure 07 · Spline regularity and forward-rate stability
svg.desc: Interpolators are applied to integrated rates h(T) = −log D(T) = Tz(T). PCHIP preserves the monotonicity of h when the nodes are monotone; this illustration is not an implementation of Hagan–West monotone convex interpolation.
